```{r data-quality-metrics, include=FALSE}
# Calculate data quality metrics dynamically
dq_total_holdings <- nrow(portfolio)
dq_total_funds <- length(unique(portfolio$index))
dq_total_countries <- n_distinct(portfolio$alpha3[!is.na(portfolio$alpha3) & portfolio$alpha3 != "-"])

# Fund coverage
dq_holdings_with_fund <- sum(!is.na(portfolio$index) & portfolio$index != "")
dq_fund_coverage <- (dq_holdings_with_fund / dq_total_holdings) * 100

# Geographic classification
dq_holdings_with_country <- sum(!is.na(portfolio$alpha3) & portfolio$alpha3 != "-")
dq_geographic_coverage <- (dq_holdings_with_country / dq_total_holdings) * 100
dq_holdings_without_country <- dq_total_holdings - dq_holdings_with_country

# Security identification (ticker)
dq_holdings_with_ticker <- sum(!is.na(portfolio$ticker) & portfolio$ticker != "")
dq_ticker_coverage <- (dq_holdings_with_ticker / dq_total_holdings) * 100
dq_holdings_without_ticker <- dq_total_holdings - dq_holdings_with_ticker

# Total weight
dq_total_weight <- sum(portfolio$weight, na.rm = TRUE)

# Duplicate ISINs
# NA ISINs (Cash/Low Risk Bonds pseudo-holdings, and constituents without an
# ISIN) must be excluded before count(): it buckets all NAs into one group,
# which would otherwise register as a single fake "ISIN repeated N times".
dq_duplicate_isins <- portfolio %>%
  filter(!is.na(ISIN)) %>%
  count(ISIN) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  nrow()

# Sector coverage: reuse sector_coverage_pct (risk-metrics-calculation chunk,
# above), which joins on ticker via ticker_sector_lookup - the same
# classification used everywhere else in the report (sunburst,
# bubble chart, tornado chart). Previously this recomputed its own figure via
# a separate ISIN-keyed join against tickerliste, which could disagree with
# sector_coverage_pct for any holding whose ticker is classified but ISIN is
# NA (or vice versa) - two different "sector coverage" numbers shown as if
# they were the same thing.
dq_sector_coverage <- sector_coverage_pct

# Holdings with weight < 0.01%
dq_low_weight_holdings <- sum(portfolio$weight < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
dq_low_weight_pct <- (dq_low_weight_holdings / dq_total_holdings) * 100

# Min/max coverage percentages for rounding in text
dq_min_coverage <- min(dq_fund_coverage, dq_geographic_coverage, dq_ticker_coverage)
dq_max_coverage <- max(dq_fund_coverage, dq_geographic_coverage, dq_ticker_coverage)

# EUR price conversion: cached price rows load_cached_prices_eur() had to drop
# (no currency in the currency map, or dated before the first / after the last
# usable FX rate). They are excluded from every risk and return figure, so
# the report says how many and which tickers, weighted by how much of the
# portfolio they carry (0 = not held, e.g. a renamed ticker's stale series).
dq_price_rows_dropped <- nrow(price_conversion_dropped)
dq_price_rows_total   <- nrow(closing_prices_clean) + dq_price_rows_dropped
dq_first_fx_date      <- suppressWarnings(min(load_fx_rates()$Date))

dq_ticker_weight <- ticker_summary %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  summarise(weight_pct = sum(weight_pct), .groups = "drop")

dq_price_dropped_by_ticker <- price_conversion_dropped %>%
  mutate(reason = if_else(is.na(currency), "no currency", "no FX rate")) %>%
  count(ticker, reason, name = "rows") %>%
  left_join(dq_ticker_weight, by = "ticker") %>%
  mutate(weight_pct = replace_na(weight_pct, 0)) %>%
  arrange(desc(weight_pct), desc(rows))

# Implausible single-day moves in the cached prices (possible instruments
# spliced under one ticker); see find_price_jumps() in price_cache.R.
dq_price_jumps <- find_price_jumps(closing_prices_clean) %>%
  left_join(dq_ticker_weight, by = "ticker") %>%
  mutate(weight_pct = replace_na(weight_pct, 0))
dq_proxied <- fund_data %>% filter(!is.na(proxy_file))
dq_proxy_note <- if (nrow(dq_proxied) == 0) {
  "none — every fund uses its published holdings."
} else {
  paste0(paste0(dq_proxied$label, " is modelled with the holdings of ", sub("\\.xlsx$", "", dq_proxied$proxy_file),
                " (config/fund_proxies.csv) instead of its published holdings, which are not its economic exposure (e.g. a swap ETF's collateral basket)",
                collapse = "; "), ". Section 7.2 shows how well that approximation tracks the fund.")
}
dq_price_jump_note <- if (nrow(dq_price_jumps) == 0) {
  "no single-day price move beyond -33% / +49% in any cached series."
} else {
  paste0(nrow(dq_price_jumps), " single-day move(s) beyond -33% / +49% - possible mixed instruments, ",
         "check before trusting these series: ",
         paste0(head(dq_price_jumps$ticker, 6), " on ", head(dq_price_jumps$Date, 6),
                " (", round((exp(head(dq_price_jumps$log_return, 6)) - 1) * 100), "%)", collapse = "; "), ".")
}

dq_price_conversion_note <- if (dq_price_rows_dropped == 0) {
  "all cached price rows were converted to EUR."
} else {
  described <- dq_price_dropped_by_ticker %>%
    slice_head(n = 6) %>%
    mutate(text = paste0(ticker, " (", reason, ", ", rows, " rows, ",
                         round(weight_pct, 2), "% of portfolio weight)"))
  paste0(
    scales::comma(dq_price_rows_dropped), " of ", scales::comma(dq_price_rows_total),
    " cached price rows (", round(dq_price_rows_dropped / dq_price_rows_total * 100, 1),
    "%) could not be converted to EUR and are excluded from all risk and return figures: ",
    paste(described$text, collapse = "; "),
    if (nrow(dq_price_dropped_by_ticker) > 6) paste0("; and ", nrow(dq_price_dropped_by_ticker) - 6, " more") else "",
    ". Rows dated before the first cached FX rate (", format(dq_first_fx_date), ") can't be converted."
  )
}
```

## 7. Data Quality and Completeness

The portfolio dataset demonstrates **robust data quality across primary identifier fields**, with `r round(dq_min_coverage, 1)`–`r round(dq_max_coverage, 1)`% completeness for critical attributes including fund source allocation, security identifiers (ISIN, ticker), geographic classification, and portfolio weights. Across `r scales::comma(dq_total_holdings)` total holdings spanning `r dq_total_funds` fund sources and `r dq_total_countries` countries, the data exhibits strong structural integrity suitable for detailed portfolio analysis.

**Key Quality Metrics:**

- **Fund Source Coverage**: `r round(dq_fund_coverage, 1)`% — All holdings successfully attributed to source funds
- **Geographic Classification**: `r round(dq_geographic_coverage, 1)`% — `r scales::comma(dq_holdings_with_country)` of `r scales::comma(dq_total_holdings)` holdings mapped to countries; `r dq_holdings_without_country` holdings lack country codes
- **Security Identification**: `r round(dq_ticker_coverage, 1)`% — Ticker symbols present for `r scales::comma(dq_holdings_with_ticker)` holdings; `r dq_holdings_without_ticker` missing
- **Portfolio Weight Integrity**: All weights positive and properly allocated across funds; fund allocations sum to `r round(dq_total_weight, 2)` units (reflects position-level weighting from underlying constituent data)
- **Duplicate Handling**: `r dq_duplicate_isins` ISINs appear multiple times across fund holdings—expected due to multi-fund exposure (e.g., major indices held across multiple ETFs)

**Data Limitations:**

- **Sector Classification**: `r round(dq_sector_coverage, 1)`% coverage (by equity weight), concentrated in US-listed equities. European and international securities remain unclassified due to data availability constraints from Finnhub API
- **Price Conversion (EUR)**: `r dq_price_conversion_note`
- **Price Jumps**: `r dq_price_jump_note`
- **Sleeve Model**: Cash and Low Risk Bonds have no price history; the whole-portfolio figures in Section 2.1 use assumed returns and volatilities for them (`r paste0(sleeve_assumptions$ticker, ": ", sleeve_assumptions$annual_return_pct, "% return, ", sleeve_assumptions$volatility_pct, "% volatility", collapse = "; ")`, uncorrelated with everything else; `config/sleeve_assumptions.csv`).
- **Proxy Holdings**: `r dq_proxy_note`
- **Minor Gaps**:`r dq_holdings_without_country + dq_holdings_without_ticker` holdings (`r round((dq_holdings_without_country + dq_holdings_without_ticker) / dq_total_holdings * 100, 1)`%) lack ticker/country information; `r dq_low_weight_holdings` holdings (`r round(dq_low_weight_pct, 1)`%) have near-zero weights below 0.01%, likely representing rounding or fund rebalancing artefacts

**Assessment**: Portfolio data is **production-quality** for geographic, fund allocation, and concentration analyses. Sector-level analysis is limited due to sparse coverage; international holdings should be analyzed by country/fund source rather than sector.

### 7.1 Methodology

This analysis aggregates holdings from multiple ETF positions, weighting each constituent according to the proportion of the portfolio allocated to that fund. Country assignments are based on the primary listing location of each security. Fund identification includes the source index or ETF from which each position originates. Volatility and returns are annualized by each series' own quote frequency (observations per calendar year: about 365 for cryptocurrencies, which are quoted every day, about 250 for stocks, and `r round(window_k)` for the shared return panel, which only keeps dates on which every holding traded), so series with different numbers of quotes stay comparable. Sector data is sourced from Finnhub and currently covers US-listed equities only.

### 7.2 Fund Look-Through vs. the Fund's Own Price Series

```{r fund-tracking, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fund_tracking <- compute_fund_tracking_table(fund_data, load_etf_listings(), closing_prices_clean)
fund_tracking <- fund_tracking %>%
  left_join(fund_data %>% select(fund_file = file, proxy_file), by = "fund_file")
```

```{r fund-tracking-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(fund_tracking) == 0) {
  cat("_No fund in this portfolio has a price series configured in `config/etf_listings.csv`._\n")
} else {
  fund_tracking %>%
    transmute(
      Fund = if_else(is.na(proxy_file), label, paste0(label, " (proxy: ", sub("\\.xlsx$", "", proxy_file), ")")),
      `Holdings covered` = paste0(n_covered, " / ", n_holdings),
      `Weight covered %` = round(coverage_pct, 1),
      `Shared days` = n_obs,
      Correlation = round(correlation, 2),
      Beta = round(beta, 2),
      `R²` = round(r_squared, 2),
      `Tracking error % p.a.` = round(tracking_error_pct, 1),
      `Return fund %` = round(cum_fund_pct, 1),
      `Return rebuilt %` = round(cum_rebuilt_pct, 1),
      Note = note
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Look-through series rebuilt from the fund's holdings vs. the fund's own EUR price series") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
    print()
}
```

Each fund's holdings (today's weights, renormalized over the holdings that have a current price history) are rebuilt into a daily return series and compared with the fund's own price series over the same days. It is a **consistency check, not a measurement of the fund's true tracking error**: a low `Weight covered` means only the largest holdings are rebuilt, which alone lowers correlation and raises the difference; US stocks close after the European fund listing, which lowers same-day correlation further. A fund that covers most of its weight but still shows a low correlation and a very different return deserves a look at the holdings file itself — typical causes are a wrong ISIN/listing in `config/etf_listings.csv`, wrong ticker mappings, or a **synthetic (swap-based) ETF, whose published holdings are its collateral basket and not the index it delivers**.

## 8. Important Information

This report was generated programmatically from `r cfg$display_name`'s holdings data on `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")` with prices up to `r format(data_as_of, "%B %d, %Y")` and is intended for personal portfolio monitoring only. It does not constitute investment advice, a recommendation, or an offer to buy or sell any security. Volatility figures are annualized and derived from historical daily prices; the inputs of Section 2.3 fall back to sector-estimated or fixed assumptions where no price history exists (`r sum(portfolio_risk$vol_source == "Historical")` of its `r nrow(portfolio_risk)` holdings use historical volatility). Past performance and historical correlation are not indicative of future results. All figures in this report are calculated directly from the underlying holdings and price data at render time and will change as that data is refreshed.
